claude.instruction: Use installed skills and Task only where the resolved backend/model/effort is supported. Otherwise use packaged role dispatch. Never silently inherit the parent model.

hermes.instruction: Enable the packaged adapters/hermes plugin for native session, tool, and delegation hooks. Use clavain_dispatch for governed delegation; preserve profile personalities and credentials.

gemini.instruction: Use the host's supported file and shell tools. Native model switching and delegation enforcement are unsupported; use Clavain role dispatch for governed work.

kimi.instruction: Use Kimi's installed skills and shell tools. Native custom subagent routing is unsupported; use Clavain role dispatch and retain its model/effort receipt.

opencode.instruction: Use supported OpenCode tools. Native agent inheritance does not enforce this contract; use Clavain role dispatch for governed delegation.

cursor.instruction: Apply this rule in every substantive task. Editor model selection remains user controlled. Native routing enforcement is unsupported; invoke packaged role dispatch from the terminal.

vscode.instruction: Apply these instructions to agent work. Model selection remains host controlled. Native routing enforcement is unsupported; invoke packaged role dispatch from the terminal.
